CustomField.label: Family Key
CustomField.description: Optional grouping key shared by platforms that behave alike for assessment purposes, e.g. hubspot and marketo both sitting in inbound_suite. It is the second link in the instrument's resolution chain (exact pair, then source-family x target, then target-only, then base), so a family-level pack can say the true thing about several sources at once without anyone copying a pack per platform. Purely additive: a platform with no family simply skips that link.
